text: あやしい　やつが　どうくつを　うろついてるんだ　きみは…？

structure.jp: どうくつを　うろついてるんだ

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; てる is the short spoken form. うろついてる = 'is prowling around'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and shows the speaker is explaining the situation. うろついてるんだ = 'the thing is, someone is prowling around'.

patterns.name: 〜を (moving through)
patterns.span: どうくつを　うろついてる
patterns.explanation: With verbs of moving, を shows the place you move around in. どうくつを　うろついてる = 'prowling around the cave'.
